title: Australian Search Party
author: Charles H. (Charles Henry) Eden
longDescription: Eden is a historical account written in the late 19th century, detailing an expedition to find the crew of a shipwrecked schooner in Australia.

authorInfo.bio: Charles H. (Charles Henry) Eden (1839–1900) wrote Australian Search Party. Their work forms part of the historical literary record preserved in this edition. The linked reference offers further details about their life and bibliography.
